code.description: A unique code for this variant. Essentially an ID for each variant type.

states.description: A list of all the valid states for this variant. Only required if LoadFromProperties or LoadFromPropertiesCombine are not set

combine.description: How this variant combines with other variant types to create individual objects.

loadFromProperties.description: If set, copies a WorldProperties asset to create variants from.

loadFromPropertiesCombine.description: A set of world properties to combine to create variants from.

onVariant.description: Required if using the SelectiveMultiply in Combine.
